patterns_discovered.description: Client-side JS (frappe.ui.form.on) for real-time UX feedback + server-side Python validate() for data integrity
patterns_discovered.principle: Server-side is single source of truth; client-side is for UX responsiveness only

patterns_discovered.description: All numeric operations use Frappe's flt(value, precision) to safely handle None, empty strings, and rounding
patterns_discovered.applies_to: All 22 child tables with numeric computations

patterns_discovered.description: Row-level fields calculated first (amount, line_subtotal, tax_amount, etc.), then parent fields aggregate from rows (subtotal, discount_amount, total_amount)
patterns_discovered.lifecycle: items_add, items_remove, field_change events trigger full parent recalculation

patterns_discovered.description: JS and Python implement identical formulas to prevent divergence bugs
patterns_discovered.scope: Order Item, Sub Order Item, Quotation Item, RFQ Quote Item, Cart Line, Marketplace Order Item, Payment Installment, Product Pricing Tier, Shipping Zone Rate, Risk Score Factor

patterns_discovered.description: Calling calculate_totals() multiple times produces identical results
patterns_discovered.benefit: Safe to call on any field change without side effects

patterns_discovered.description: Distinct handling for add, delete, and modify scenarios in child table operations

gotchas_discovered.description: JS and Python implementations must be identical; any divergence is a bug that will cause data consistency issues
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Pair each JS handler with corresponding Python formula; add test cases verifying both paths produce same result

gotchas_discovered.description: Must use flt() everywhere to safely handle None, empty strings, and type coercion
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Never use direct arithmetic on form fields; always wrap with flt()

gotchas_discovered.description: Client-side calculations are UX only; server-side validate() is authoritative and may override client values
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Assume client-side bypass; never trust client calculations for data persistence

gotchas_discovered.description: Discount amounts can exceed line_subtotal if not validated; fixed discounts must be capped
gotchas_discovered.example: Sub Order Item: min(discount_value, line_subtotal) for fixed discounts

gotchas_discovered.description: Shipping can be row-level or parent-level; must clarify which child tables support which
gotchas_discovered.scope: Sub Order Item, Cart Line, Marketplace Order Item have shipping_amount fields

gotchas_discovered.description: Commission rate can be row-level percent or derived from parent subtotal; division by zero if subtotal is 0
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Check if subtotal > 0 before computing commission_rate; else set to 0

gotchas_discovered.description: Summing floats can lose precision; rounding must be applied at parent level, not accumulated from rows
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Sum raw values first, then round to 2 decimals at parent level
